t2i_prompt: A 1440 px wide desktop web section as a flat straight-on UI mockup on deep navy, styled as a technical blueprint. Light headline top left. Three labelled columns with mono caps headers, each holding square-cornered outlined boxes in aligned rows for <CONTENT>. Fine 1.5 px pale blue pipe lines route from each left box with right-angle bends, through P&ID valve symbols, a small vessel and pump symbols, into the centre column and on to the right. Connector dots on box edges, small mono path codes, a drawing frame with ruler ticks and zone numbers. Flat, no shadows.
signature_idea: The industry router is a P&ID: each reader's situation is literally piped through valves to the system and the place to start.
strengths: routing metaphor matches the product (pipes, valves) and the decision logic
very legible table structure in boxes
fine line art on navy with drawing-sheet frame is core brand language
converts naturally to an interactive path-highlight component
weaknesses: serif headline is off the Geist type system
decorative P&ID equipment in the middle lines doesn't mean anything for the routing
crossing lines get busy around rows 1-2
start-with boxes duplicate across rows, could be merged
brand_fit_why: Navy ground, fine steel/pale-blue line art, drawing-sheet details, mono labels and square corners match the brand book; only the serif headline deviates.
